question.text: The end correction of a resonance column is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>1</mn><mo> </mo><mi>cm</mi></math>. If the shortest length resonating with the tuning fork is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>10</mn><mo> </mo><mi>cm</mi></math>, the next resonating length should be

solution.text: Given: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>e</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn><mo> </mo><mi>cm</mi></math>. For first resonance, <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mi>λ</mi><mn>4</mn></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mi> </mi><msub><mi>l</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>+</mo><mi>e</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>11</mn><mi> </mi><mi>cm</mi></math>. For second resonance, <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mrow><mn>3</mn><mi>λ</mi></mrow><mn>4</mn></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mi> </mi><msub><mi>l</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>+</mo><mi>e</mi><mi> </mi><mo>⇒</mo><mi> </mi><msub><mi>l</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn><mi> </mi><mo>×</mo><mn>11</mn><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>32</mn><mi> </mi><mi>cm</mi></math>.
